body:
This is a preview-only sample so you can see the layout before go-live. It is not shown on the live forzakarate.co.uk site.

On a real post, the cover photo appears uncropped on the news card (the same way as the Kobe badge). The first photo is the article hero, and the rest open in a gallery you can tap through.

Write and publish posts from Forza Club Honbu Office, under News. You can select several photos at once, add more later, reorder them, choose the cover, and add captions.
